summary: Canadian Solar filed a Form 6-K announcing a leadership change at its subsidiary Recurrent Energy: CEO Ismael Guerrero is stepping down, effective immediately, with Dylan Marx (formerly COO of Canadian Solar) appointed as his successor. Guerrero will serve in a non-executive advisory role through December 31, 2026. The change is effective July 6, 2026; no financial terms, board recommendation, or advisor named. This is a sudden departure at a key subsidiary, not a routine appointment, reflecting a forced/abrupt management transition. Watch for potential impacts on Recurrent Energy's project pipeline execution and any broader strategic shifts at Canadian Solar.
